data.opportunityTitle: Small Business Transportation Technical Assistance Center (Region 6)
data.modifiedComments: Update of Cost Share and Match Requirement

synopsis.synopsisDesc:
The U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT), Office of the Secretary (OST), Office of Small and Disadvantaged Business Utilization (OSDBU), announces the availability of funding under Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) Number OST/OSDBU-2026-SBTTAC-Region 6-FY2026-1 to establish and operate the Region 6 Small Business Transportation Technical Assistance Center (SBTTAC) formerly known as the Small Business Transportation Resource Centers (SBTRC).The cooperative agreement is for one award for a 12 months base year with two option years, based on performance.


Link to Recorded NOFO Information Session (Webinar) - Aug 3, 2026, 1PM ET

https://usdot.zoomgov.com/rec/share/84PjqpAOpvEeyc1B7HP-fmGEdi2tR7Le7sjEnHbep3ssbGuAideifzgmo282RsBh.lucHhIC2nlBYIlks?startTime=1785776732000 

Passcode: Nzy1RYQ=
